title: The pants graph as a combinatorial model for the Teichmüller space of a non-orientable surface
summary: We study the relation between the pants graph of a non-orientable surface and that of its orientable double cover. Given a non-orientable surface $N$ with orientable double cover $π\colon S\to N$, we construct a natural map between pants graphs induced by lifting pants decompositions. We prove that this map defines a quasi-isometric embedding of $\mathrm{Pants}(N)$ into $\mathrm{Pants}(S)$.
